audit.changesRead: Latest request and all other-main appended commentary; newly added download-preview contract fully read. Remaining specifications exact-hash reused.

finding: ProgressivePagePreview mounts GalleryThumbnail only when original.kind is failed. Preparing/prepared originals deliberately replace even an already resolved matching preview with a spinner. The original backend bypasses the thumbnail cache; this is a presentation regression, not proof of corrupt or missing cache.
decisions: Mount the exact page thumbnail immediately and keep it visible while original preparation, media loading or decoding is pending. Promote only the matching successfully decoded original.
Use the shared thumbnail coordinator to reuse ready/in-flight pages and canonical disk cache rather than a second image cache or direct image URL manipulation.

Remote page one can reuse its known cover only when an exact page preview is not already present. Never show a cover as a placeholder for a later page. Completed local albums use an artifact-page fallback, preserving local original priority and avoiding a new source thumbnail download.

Keep a thumbnail underneath a displayed original so a display error can reveal it without a second loading gap; at most the visible one/two pages subscribe. Preserve the bounded two-reader original pool and neighbouring prefetch range.

Fence late original and decode results by request and image identity. Warm already-complete original images must promote without depending solely on a fresh load event. Original dimensions supersede later thumbnail dimensions.

Preserve the previous always-visible counts, Downloads double-click and Q/E navigation changes, original file quality, privacy, page identity, close/disposal and all recording/download jobs. No release requested.
supersedes: Original-first failure-only thumbnail presentation is replaced by thumbnail-first display while the full original is prepared; the original download/quality and pool limits remain unchanged.
acceptance: Reproduce a warm cached page plus delayed original before fixing.
Cached preview remains during preparation and image decoding; original errors keep preview; uncached pages resolve through the existing coordinator.
Pool-backed real Detail path, page/album switching, stale responses, local artifact fallback, cover versus non-cover page, already-complete image, and cleanup tests.
Headless browser with synthetic media verifies actual pixels/visibility before and after delayed original decoding; no user media transmitted.
Run affected tests/typecheck/build. Native application verification remains pending if active-work normal-exit gate refuses restart; never drain/kill jobs.
notes: The preview remains underneath the original during its existing opacity transition, with an opaque original background, avoiding a black frame during crossfade.
No backend/network-original algorithm was changed. Test-only DetailWorkspace selectors now distinguish the bounded contact sheet from the additional enlarged-preview fallback.
